covers: A fresh Settings instance and .env.example default COMFY_API_PORT to 8092 while explicit environment/.env/-Port values still take precedence.
The launcher and checker share that default and distinguish a full H3-enabled control-plane listener from a health-only legacy listener without a process mutation.
The operating documentation directs the management page to 8092 by default and retains the no-stop boundary for both observed listeners.
Tests pass, secret scan finds no credentials, and the H3 manifest remains deferred without a model-file inspection.
